name: Amona Player for Plex
summary:
Amona Player turns your Meta Quest 3, 3S, 2 or Pro into a private movie theater for your own Plex library. Link your Plex account with a code, pick a room, and play your movies and shows on a giant screen. 

• Immersive rooms: an Art Deco cinema, a home cinema, a night train, an underwater suite, or your own room in passthrough. 
• 3D with real depth: side-by-side 3D movies are detected and shown in depth. 
• The original sound: DTS and TrueHD decoded right on the headset.
